users.title: Users
users.empty: There are no users with these filters.
users.providerRefHint: The identifier (UUID) of the application approved in Providers. It defines which business the account is linked to.
users.providerRefError: Enter a valid identifier (UUID) of the approved provider
users.deleteWarning: The account will be deleted, or pseudonymized if a legal retention obligation applies. This action is audited.
users.auditNotice: The change will be recorded in the audit log.
users.roleUpdated: The role was updated and the change was recorded in the audit log

matrix.title: Authorization matrix
matrix.description: Every publication creates a new version of the RBAC matrix.
matrix.editorHint: Array of objects with rol, recurso, accion and permitir (true/false).
matrix.invalidJson: The JSON is not valid: each permission needs a role, a resource and an array of actions.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Immutable log of actions on users and content, and the event outbox status.
audit.retried: The event went back to the queue

providers.title: Providers
providers.assignRoleHint: To enable the portal, go to Users, find the applicant's account and assign the Provider role with this identifier.
providers.empty: There are no providers with these filters.
providers.name: Provider
providers.noActions: There are no actions available for this status.
providers.reasonRequired: A reason is required to reject or suspend

moderation.title: Editorial moderation
moderation.description: Choose a provider and review their content. Actions run on behalf of that provider (X-Tenant-Id).
moderation.empty: There is no content with that status.
moderation.name: Name
moderation.reasonRequired: Enter the reason to return or reject

types.title: Provider types
types.description: Each type defines its attribute schema (JSON Schema).
types.name: Name
types.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscore; starts with a letter. It cannot be changed later.
types.codeFormat: Use only lowercase letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter
types.invalidJson: The schema is not valid JSON
types.conflict: The type changed while you were editing it. Close the panel and open it again.

credentials.title: Integration credentials
credentials.description: API keys (X-Api-Key) that each provider uses in its integrations.
credentials.copyNow: Copy the key now: it will not be shown again.
credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.nameHint: To recognize it, e.g. Booking system integration.

environment.title: Carrying capacity
environment.description: Occupancy thresholds, immutable versions and good practices per attraction.

order.preventive: Must be greater than the recommendation threshold
order.critical: Must be greater than the preventive threshold
order.validity: Must be on or after the start date

capacity.notConfigured: This attraction has no carrying capacity configured yet. Fill in the data and publish the first version.
capacity.expired: The capacity criterion has expired. Update the validity or the source.
capacity.restrict: Restrict bookings when the critical threshold is reached
capacity.restrictHint: M3 will reject new bookings with RESERVA_RESTRINGIDA.
capacity.immutable: Every change creates a new immutable version; previous ones are kept.

conflict.intro: Record the decision when an external source (for example CORPAMAG) differs from the internal capacity.
conflict.externalCapacity: Capacity according to the external source

occupancy.title: Estimated occupancy
occupancy.none: This attraction has no estimated occupancy yet: configure its carrying capacity so M8 can compute it.

practices.notNatural: Only natural attractions support environmental good practices.
practices.hint: It will be shown to tourists on the attraction page.

retention.title: Historical data retention
retention.description: Minimum period that occupancy series are kept.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Service health, environmental alerts and report pipeline status.

alerts.title: Alert inbox
alerts.empty: There are no alerts in this status.
alerts.mustAcknowledge: The alert must be acknowledged before it can be closed.
